# Set47 independent retained-bout reference plan

The authority is the frozen Set47 core/helper contracts recorded by `set47-contract-freeze.json` (e023ddb4c043ae09b6edd826e0fbd1765d3e8bd02c34bcf0ce0ed10205d8c2fe). Runtime basis is Set46 ede24725, whose package latency investigation is still open. This reference pins unchanged arithmetic/schema, not a successful Set46 release. It will not read new Set47 Go source or outputs. All work stays in `set47-bout-reference` outside Git; root reviews and freezes it before comparison.

## Inputs and independent derivation

Copy exact frozen Set42 integer engine Python and only its small manifest/DNA/table dependencies. Select named condition/calendar functions from unchanged frozen Python sources by an explicit AST allowlist; preserve entire original source bytes and extraction hashes. Retain the old engine freeze and selected old engine cases as inherited controls, without copying the entire recursive corpus. Set46 Rules, Pin, Views, Event and selected source rows are exact JSON-pointer extracts with original file SHA, pointer and extraction encoding. All original files stay immutable.

The genuine source case uses the independently verified Set46 public card's booked bout, its original cutoff Members and the final public receipt wrappers. Bind the existing chain/card/admission verification reports and exact public artifact hashes. Do not rerun normal PoW or relabel this compact projection a portable admission/ownership proof. The current conflicted overlay remains separate from the original immutable booking. Model-only sources for missing classes and attribution permutations are labelled structural fixture projections, never newly admitted normal-PoW records.

Expected engine Input is independently composed from original WorkHash-derived manifests, original birth, event cutoff, booked seed and zero XP/training. Expected complete Result comes only from the frozen independent Set42 integer engine. Engine InputID/ResultDigest preserve their original unframed domains; new Store/Source/Record commitments use the exact Set47 length framing. No fitting, coefficient changes, new randomness or runtime-derived expected bytes.

## Finite coverage

- One genuine booked source plus ten model-only sources: all five classes with both fixture attribution orders under ascending ProspectIDs. Include prime/decline cutoff conditions and a later run after retirement whose Input and Result remain the original cutoff values.
- Full canonical BoutSource, Input, InputID, Result, ResultDigest and Record for each composition. Explicit deterministic repeat, creation-time-only record change, original View-independent identity, booked-seed sensitivity and no current-condition substitution controls.
- Closed core DTOs and helper Snapshot/Status/CardStatus/Run/Read/Job/Portrait envelopes. Both current fixture Views, setup/unavailable/empty-card/unsaved/saved/historical-conflict states, at most five metadata rows and one transcript. Core semantic validators versus cheap transport validators are separate contexts; cheap polling does not claim to regenerate manifests, conditions or fights.
- Bounded codec recipes: ordered/reordered/whitespace, legal canonical escapes, unknown/missing/duplicate fields, wrong scalar type, integer spellings/ranges, exact signed nested paths, nullability, array/depth limits and cap-with-LF controls. Store accepted representative bytes once and retain finite mutation recipes rather than recursively duplicate full transcripts.
- Protocol correlation: exact original View/store/date/bout, queued-only ACK, no running-to-queued regression, terminal immutability, discovered jobs, refused stale selections, and fresh portrait Status binding. Successful saved historical reads remain distinct from unsaved conflict refusal.
- Small state models: empty/install/resume/crash-prefix recognition, once-only Run, replay/read without simulation, clock rollback, capacity 255/256/257 saved bouts independent of card count, cancellation before commit versus unknown after possible commit, close/reopen recovery and same-card row consistency. These are modeled expectations, not executed crash or account/chain tests.
- Reuse pinned Saturday/DST boundary arithmetic and selected inherited engine rare-finish controls. New booked cases need not realize every rare engine method; no seed search for favorable outcomes.

## Artifact and freeze protocol

`input_index.json` records byte-exact origins or JSON pointers. `bout_v1.json` will contain `compositions`, `dtos`, `codec_cases`, `protocol_cases`, `identity_cases`, `scenarios`, `initialization`, `calendar` and formula bounds with per-case provenance/context. `README.md` documents recipe grammar, semantic limits and test-consumer selectors. A verifier regenerates exact bytes and checks every finite case, hashes inputs before/after, and runs serially under `/usr/bin/python3` and Homebrew Python with distinct hash seeds/timezones. Source/index/verification/freeze hashes are separate. Preserve any reviewed draft correction before changing it.

Engine generation is temporarily deferred while Set46 helper metadata latency measurements run. Input hashing, extraction and schema preparation can proceed. No oracle is frozen or authorized for runtime comparison yet.
